ops.body: Retitled 2026-08-30. The original title led with the brew-exit-status defect, which reads as a live origin/main bug; it is not — captain_hook/update/updater.py:88-105 fixed it in 12.22.4. The task's actionable content is the second half: three independently-pinned copies of captain-hook on one machine with nothing reporting the split, and a uv-pinned CLI shim that is both the component responsible for noticing staleness and the one guaranteed to lie about it. The title now leads with that.
